**Severity:** error · **Area:** Resume (`RV2xxx`) · **Quick fix:** none

## Message

The diagnostic reads:

```text
Resumable code cannot capture `this`
```

## How to fix

Use an arrow function and read the element from event.currentTarget (or a ref) instead of `this`.

## Example

```tsx avoid nocheck
export function A() { return <div onClick={function () { this; }} />; }
```

```tsx prefer
export function A() { return <div onClick={(event) => event.currentTarget} />; }
```

## When it is reported

Resume mode.
